p0.original: The rise and fall in the profits of stock depend upon the same causes with the rise and fall in the wages of labour, the increasing or declining state of the wealth of the society; but those causes affect the one and the other very differently.
p0.zh: 股票利润的增减取决于同样的原因,即劳动工资的增减,社会财富的增减状况;但这些原因对两者的影响却非常不同.

p1.original: The increase of stock, which raises wages, tends to lower profit. When the stocks of many rich merchants are turned into the same trade, their mutual competition naturally tends to lower its profit; and when there is a like increase of stock in all the different trades carried on in the same society, the same competition must produce the same effect in them all.
p1.zh: 提高工资的股票增加往往会降低利润。 当许多富商的股票变成同一个贸易时,他们的相互竞争自然会降低利润;当同一社会进行的所有不同贸易的股票都出现类似增加时,同样的竞争必须在它们中产生同样的效果.

p2.original: It is not easy, it has already been observed, to ascertain what are the average wages of labour, even in a particular place, and at a particular time. We can, even in this case, seldom determine more than what are the most usual wages. But even this can seldom be done with regard to the profits of stock. Profit is so very fluctuating, that the person who carries on a particular trade, cannot always tell you himself what is the average of his annual profit. It is affected, not only by every variation of price in the commodities which he deals in, but by the good or bad fortune both of his rivals and of his customers, and by a thousand other accidents, to which goods, when carried either by sea or by land, or even when stored in a warehouse, are liable. It varies, therefore, not only from year to year, but from day to day, and almost from hour to hour. To ascertain what is the average profit of all the different trades carried on in a great kingdom, must be much more difficult; and to judge of what it may have been formerly, or in remote periods of time, with any degree of precision, must be altogether impossible.
p2.zh: 人们已经注意到,确定即使在某一地点和某一时间的劳动平均工资是不容易的。 即使在这种情况下,我们也很少能确定什么是最通常的工资。 但是,即使是在股票利润方面,也很少能够做到这一点。利润如此波动,以至于从事某一行业的人不能总是告诉自己年平均利润是多少。 它不仅受到他所交易的商品价格的每个变化的影响,而且受到对手和客户的好坏,以及受到其他一千起事故的影响,货物在海上或陆地上运输,甚至储存在仓库中时,都要对此负责。 因此,它不仅年复一年,而且日复一日,几乎是时不时的。 要确定在一个伟大的王国中进行的所有不同贸易的平均利润,必须困难得多;要判断它以前可能是什么,或者在遥远的时期,以任何程度的精确,必须完全不可能。

p3.original: But though it may be impossible to determine, with any degree of precision, what are or were the average profits of stock, either in the present or in ancient times, some notion may be formed of them from the interest of money. It may be laid down as a maxim, that wherever a great deal can be made by the use of money, a great deal will commonly be given for the use of it; and that, wherever little can be made by it, less will commonly he given for it. Accordingly, therefore, as the usual market rate of interest varies in any country, we may be assured that the ordinary profits of stock must vary with it, must sink as it sinks, and rise as it rises. The progress of interest, therefore, may lead us to form some notion of the progress of profit.
p3.zh: 但是,尽管可能无法精确地确定,无论是在现在还是古代,股票的平均利润是多少,还是多少,但从金钱的利益来看,可能形成一些概念。可能规定为一句格言,凡用钱能作大功的,一般都给钱用;凡用钱能作小功的,一般都给钱用小功. 因此,由于任何国家的正常市场利率都不同,我们可以确信,股票的普通利润必须随其变化而变化,必须随其下降而下降,并随其上升而上升。 因此,利益的进步可能使我们形成某种利润进步的概念。

p4.original: By the 37th of Henry VIII. all interest above ten per cent. was declared unlawful. More, it seems, had sometimes been taken before that. In the reign of Edward VI. religious zeal prohibited all interest. This prohibition, however, like all others of the same kind, is said to have produced no effect, and probably rather increased than diminished the evil of usury. The statute of Henry VIII. was revived by the 13th of Elizabeth, cap. 8. and ten per cent. continued to be the legal rate of interest till the 21st of James I. when it was restricted to eight per cent. It was reduced to six per cent. soon after the Restoration, and by the 12th of Queen Anne, to five per cent. All these different statutory regulations seem to have been made with great propriety. They seem to have followed, and not to have gone before, the market rate of interest, or the rate at which people of good credit usually borrowed. Since the time of Queen Anne, five per cent. seems to have been rather above than below the market rate. Before the late war, the government borrowed at three per cent.; and people of good credit in the capital, and in many other parts of the kingdom, at three and a-half, four, and four and a-half per cent.
p4.zh: 到了亨利八世的37日,所有超过10%的利息被宣布为非法.在此之前,似乎还曾采取过更多的措施。 在爱德华六世的统治中,宗教狂热禁止一切利益. 然而,这项禁令与所有其他同类禁令一样,据说没有产生任何效果,而且可能增加而不是减少高利贷的罪恶。亨利八世的法规由伊丽莎白第13世复活,封顶.8. 和10%继续是法定利率,直到21日詹姆斯一世将其限制在8%。后降为6%,恢复后不久,至安皇后十二世时降为5%. 所有这些不同的法定条例似乎都是以非常适当的方式制定的。 它们似乎遵循而不是之前遵循了市场利率,或者良好信贷者通常借贷的利率。 自安妮王后时代以来,5%. . 似乎已经远远高于而不是低于市场率.战国末期以前,政府借款百分之三;首都有良好信用的人,以及王国其他许多地区,贷款百分之三半,百分之四,百分之四半.

p5.original: Since the time of Henry VIII. the wealth and revenue of the country have been continually advancing, and in the course of their progress, their pace seems rather to have been gradually accelerated than retarded. They seem not only to have been going on, but to have been going on faster and faster. The wages of labour have been continually increasing during the same period, and, in the greater part of the different branches of trade and manufactures, the profits of stock have been diminishing.
p5.zh: 自亨利八世时代起,国家的财富和收入不断进步,在进步的过程中,他们的步调似乎比弱智逐渐加快. 他们似乎不仅一直在进行,而且越来越快地进行下去。同期,劳动工资不断上涨,在贸易和制造的不同部门中,大部分的股票利润不断下降。

p6.original: It generally requires a greater stock to carry on any sort of trade in a great town than in a country village. The great stocks employed in every branch of trade, and the number of rich competitors, generally reduce the rate of profit in the former below what it is in the latter. But the wages of labour are generally higher in a great town than in a country village. In a thriving town, the people who have great stocks to employ, frequently cannot get the number of workmen they want, and therefore bid against one another, in order to get as many as they can, which raises the wages of labour, and lowers the profits of stock. In the remote parts of the country, there is frequently not stock sufficient to employ all the people, who therefore bid against one another, in order to get employment, which lowers the wages of labour, and raises the profits of stock.
p6.zh: 一般来说,在一个伟大的城镇里进行任何种类的贸易都需要比在乡村里进行更多的库存。 每个贸易分支所雇用的大量股票以及富人竞争者的数目,一般使前者的利润率低于后者的利润率。 但是,在一个伟大的城镇,劳动工资一般高于一个乡村。在一个繁荣的城镇里,拥有大量股票的人往往得不到他们想要的工人人数,因此相互竞价,以便尽可能多地获得,这提高了劳动工资,降低了股票的利润。在国内偏远地区,往往没有足够的库存来雇用所有的人,因此他们相互竞争,以获得就业,从而降低劳动工资,增加库存利润。

p7.original: In Scotland, though the legal rate of interest is the same as in England, the market rate is rather higher. People of the best credit there seldom borrow under five per cent. Even private bankers in Edinburgh give four per cent. upon their promissory-notes, of which payment, either in whole or in part may be demanded at pleasure. Private bankers in London give no interest for the money which is deposited with them. There are few trades which cannot be carried on with a smaller stock in Scotland than in England. The common rate of profit, therefore, must be somewhat greater. The wages of labour, it has already been observed, are lower in Scotland than in England. The country, too, is not only much poorer, but the steps by which it advances to a better condition, for it is evidently advancing, seem to be much slower and more tardy. The legal rate of interest in France has not during the course of the present century, been always regulated by the market rate {See Denisart, Article Taux des Interests, tom. iii, p.13}. In 1720, interest was reduced from the twentieth to the fiftieth penny, or from five to two per cent. In 1724, it was raised to the thirtieth penny, or to three and a third per cent. In 1725, it was again raised to the twentieth penny, or to five per cent. In 1766, during the administration of Mr Laverdy, it was reduced to the twenty-fifth penny, or to four per cent. The Abbé Terray raised it afterwards to the old rate of five per cent. The supposed purpose of many of those violent reductions of interest was to prepare the way for reducing that of the public debts; a purpose which has sometimes been executed. France is, perhaps, in the present times, not so rich a country as England; and though the legal rate of interest has in France frequently been lower than in England, the market rate has generally been higher; for there, as in other countries, they have several very safe and easy methods of evading the law. The profits of trade, I have been assured by British merchants who had traded in both countries, are higher in France than in England; and it is no doubt upon this account, that many British subjects chuse rather to employ their capitals in a country where trade is in disgrace, than in one where it is highly respected. The wages of labour are lower in France than in England. When you go from Scotland to England, the difference which you may remark between the dress and countenance of the common people in the one country and in the other, sufficiently indicates the difference in their condition. The contrast is still greater when you return from France. France, though no doubt a richer country than Scotland, seems not to be going forward so fast. It is a common and even a popular opinion in the country, that it is going backwards; an opinion which I apprehend, is ill-founded, even with regard to France, but which nobody can possibly entertain with regard to Scotland, who sees the country now, and who saw it twenty or thirty years ago.
p7.zh: 在苏格兰,虽然法定利率与英国相同,但市场利率相当高.在那里的信贷最高者很少借贷不到5%。即使是爱丁堡的私人银行家也按其本票付4%,其中全部或部分付款都可以随意要求。伦敦的私人银行家对存入他们的存款不付利息。苏格兰的股票比英格兰小,因此无法继续从事的交易很少。 因此,共同利润率必须略高一些。已经观察到,苏格兰的劳动工资低于英格兰。 该国不仅更加贫穷,而且由于该国显然正在进步,它进入更好条件的步骤似乎慢得多,而且更迟缓。 法国的法律利率在本世纪中一直没有,一直受市场利率的制约{见Denisart, Article Taux des Interest, tom.iii, p.13}。1720年,利息从20美分降至50美分,或从5%降至2%.1724年,升为第三十分钱,即3分和3分.1725年,再次升为第二十分钱,即5%.1766年,在拉弗迪先生执政期间,降为二十五分钱,即百分之四.Abbé Terray公司后来将其提高到5%的旧费率。 许多这种暴力降低利息的假定目的是为减少公共债务铺平道路;这一目的有时得到落实。 法国在当今时代也许不像英国那么富裕;虽然法国的法定利率经常低于英国,但市场利率一般较高;因为在那里,像其他国家一样,它们有几种非常安全而容易逃避法律的方法.贸易的利润,在两国贸易的英国商人已经向我保证,在法国比在英国高;毫无疑问,在这个说法上,许多英国臣民选择在一个贸易受辱的国家雇用他们的首都,而不是在贸易受到高度尊重的国家。 法国的劳动工资低于英国. 当你从苏格兰到英格兰时,你可能说出一国和另一国的普通人民的服饰和礼仪之间的差别,充分表明他们的状况不同。 从法国回来时,反差更大。 法国虽然无疑是比苏格兰更富裕的国家,但似乎没有如此迅速前进。国内一种普遍甚至流行的看法是,它正在倒退;我所理解的一种观点是毫无根据的,甚至对法国也是如此,但对于苏格兰来说,没有人能够容忍,苏格兰现在看到这个国家,而且二三十年前看到它。

p8.original: The province of Holland, on the other hand, in proportion to the extent of its territory and the number of its people, is a richer country than England. The government there borrow at two per cent. and private people of good credit at three. The wages of labour are said to be higher in Holland than in England, and the Dutch, it is well known, trade upon lower profits than any people in Europe. The trade of Holland, it has been pretended by some people, is decaying, and it may perhaps be true that some particular branches of it are so; but these symptoms seem to indicate sufficiently that there is no general decay. When profit diminishes, merchants are very apt to complain that trade decays, though the diminution of profit is the natural effect of its prosperity, or of a greater stock being employed in it than before. During the late war, the Dutch gained the whole carrying trade of France, of which they still retain a very large share. The great property which they possess both in French and English funds, about forty millions, it is said in the latter (in which, I suspect, however, there is a considerable exaggeration ), the great sums which they lend to private people, in countries where the rate of interest is higher than in their own, are circumstances which no doubt demonstrate the redundancy of their stock, or that it has increased beyond what they can employ with tolerable profit in the proper business of their own country; but they do not demonstrate that that business has decreased. As the capital of a private man, though acquired by a particular trade, may increase beyond what he can employ in it, and yet that trade continue to increase too, so may likewise the capital of a great nation.
p8.zh: 另一方面,荷兰省,按其领土范围和人口数量的比例,是比英格兰更富裕的国家.那里的政府贷款2%,私人信贷3倍。 据说荷兰的劳动工资高于英格兰,荷兰人,众所周知,以比欧洲任何人更低的利润进行交易。 荷兰的贸易,被一些人假装,正在衰败,也许某些特定的分支确实如此;但这些症状似乎充分表明没有普遍衰败. 当利润减少时,商人非常愿意抱怨贸易衰败,尽管利润减少是利润繁荣的自然影响,或者比以前在利润中就业的股票更多。 在晚期战争期间,荷兰人获得了法国的整个承载贸易,其中他们仍然保有非常大的份额. 他们以法国和英国资金拥有的巨额财产,大约4 000万,据说,后者(但我认为其中夸大其词),他们在利率高于本国利率的国家向私人贷款的巨额款项,无疑表明其库存冗余,或已超过他们为本国正当业务可容忍的利润所能承受的程度;但它们并未表明这一业务已经减少。 由于私人资本虽然被某一特定贸易所获得,但可能会增加,超出他在其中所能雇用的资本,而这种贸易也在继续增加,因此,一个伟大国家的资本也可能继续增加。

p9.original: In our North American and West Indian colonies, not only the wages of labour, but the interest of money, and consequently the profits of stock, are higher than in England. In the different colonies, both the legal and the market rate of interest run from six to eight percent. High wages of labour and high profits of stock, however, are things, perhaps, which scarce ever go together, except in the peculiar circumstances of new colonies. A new colony must always, for some time, be more understocked in proportion to the extent of its territory, and more underpeopled in proportion to the extent of its stock, than the greater part of other countries. They have more land than they have stock to cultivate. What they have, therefore, is applied to the cultivation only of what is most fertile and most favourably situated, the land near the sea-shore, and along the banks of navigable rivers. Such land, too, is frequently purchased at a price below the value even of its natural produce. Stock employed in the purchase and improvement of such lands, must yield a very large profit, and, consequently, afford to pay a very large interest. Its rapid accumulation in so profitable an employment enables the planter to increase the number of his hands faster than he can find them in a new settlement. Those whom he can find, therefore, are very liberally rewarded. As the colony increases, the profits of stock gradually diminish. When the most fertile and best situated lands have been all occupied, less profit can be made by the cultivation of what is inferior both in soil and situation, and less interest can be afforded for the stock which is so employed. In the greater part of our colonies, accordingly, both the legal and the market rate of interest have been considerably reduced during the course of the present century. As riches, improvement, and population, have increased, interest has declined. The wages of labour do not sink with the profits of stock. The demand for labour increases with the increase of stock, whatever be its profits; and after these are diminished, stock may not only continue to increase, but to increase much faster than before. It is with industrious nations, who are advancing in the acquisition of riches, as with industrious individuals. A great stock, though with small profits, generally increases faster than a small stock with great profits. Money, says the proverb, makes money. When you have got a little, it is often easy to get more. The great difficulty is to get that little. The connection between the increase of stock and that of industry, or of the demand for useful labour, has partly been explained already, but will be explained more fully hereafter, in treating of the accumulation of stock.
p9.zh: 在我们的北美和西印度殖民地,不仅劳动工资,而且金钱利息,因此股票利润,都高于英国.在不同殖民地,法定利率和市场利率都从6%到8%不等。 然而,劳动力的高工资和股票的高利润或许是一些东西,除了新殖民地的特殊情况之外,它们很少在一起。一段时间以来,新殖民地必须比其他国家更多地按照其领土的面积少储,比大部分国家少储。 他们拥有的土地比他们有种的多。 因此,它们只用于种植最肥沃和最有利的土地、近海附近土地和可通航河流沿岸。 这种土地的购买价格往往甚至低于其天然产品的价值。购买和改良这类土地时使用的股票必须产生巨大的利润,因此支付非常大的利益。 它迅速积累在如此有利可图的就业机会中,使种植者能够比在新的定居点中找到更多的手。 因此,他能找到的人得到的奖励非常宽松。 随着殖民地的增加,股票的利润逐渐减少. 当最肥沃和最有利的土地全部被占用时,通过种植土壤和情况中劣质的作物而获得的利润就会减少,而对于这样雇用的牲畜的兴趣也会减少。 因此,在我们大部分殖民地,法律利率和市场利率在本世纪期间都大大下降。 随着财富、改善和人口的增加,利息下降。劳动工资不与库存利润相沉没. 对劳动力的需求随着股票的增加而增加,无论利润如何;在利润减少之后,股票不仅可能继续增加,而且会比以前更快地增加。 正是那些在获得财富方面不断进步的杰出国家,以及那些杰出的个人。大量的股票,虽然利润很小,但一般比利润很高的小股票增长得更快.钱,谚语是钱有了一点,往往很容易得到更多。最大的困难是得到那一点。库存增加与工业增加或对有用劳动力的需求之间的联系已经得到部分解释,但在处理库存积累时,下文将更全面地加以解释。

p10.original: The acquisition of new territory, or of new branches of trade, may sometimes raise the profits of stock, and with them the interest of money, even in a country which is fast advancing in the acquisition of riches. The stock of the country, not being sufficient for the whole accession of business which such acquisitions present to the different people among whom it is divided, is applied to those particular branches only which afford the greatest profit. Part of what had before been employed in other trades, is necessarily withdrawn from them, and turned into some of the new and more profitable ones. In all those old trades, therefore, the competition comes to be Jess than before. The market comes to be less fully supplied with many different sorts of goods. Their price necessarily rises more or less, and yields a greater profit to those who deal in them, who can, therefore, afford to borrow at a higher interest. For some time after the conclusion of the late war, not only private people of the best credit, but some of the greatest companies in London, commonly borrowed at five per cent. who, before that, had not been used to pay more than four, and four and a half per cent. The great accession both of territory and trade by our acquisitions in North America and the West Indies, will sufficiently account for this, without supposing any diminution in the capital stock of the society. So great an accession of new business to be carried on by the old stock, must necessarily have diminished the quantity employed in a great number of particular branches, in which the competition being less, the profits must have been greater. I shall hereafter have occasion to mention the reasons which dispose me to believe that the capital stock of Great Britain was not diminished, even by the enormous expense of the late war.
p10.zh: 收购新领地或新的贸易分支有时会提高股票的利润,并随之提高金钱的利益,即使在一个在收购财富方面进展迅速的国家也是如此。国家的股票不足以使这些收购给它所分得的不同的人的整个企业加入,而这种股票只适用于那些利润最大的特定分支机构。 以前从事其他行业的部分工作必须退出这些行业,成为一些新的和更有利可图的行业。 因此,在所有这些老行业中,竞争对手是杰西。市场上供应的商品种类不尽相同。其价格必然会上涨多少,并给交易者带来更大的利润,因此,他们能够以更高的利息借贷。后期战争结束后的一段时间里,不仅有最优秀的私人信贷,而且伦敦一些最伟大的公司,通常以5%的贷款,在此之前,他们还没有被用在支付超过四,四半的赔款上. 我们在北美和西印度群岛的收购对领土和贸易的极大吞并将充分说明这一点,而不会使社会资本存量减少。如此之大的新企业的加入,要由旧股进行,必然会减少许多特定分支部门使用的数量,其中竞争较少,利润必定更大. 我今后将有机会提到使我不得不相信,即使战争后期花费巨大,大不列颠的资本存量也没有减少。

p11.original: The diminution of the capital stock of the society, or of the funds destined for the maintenance of industry, however, as it lowers the wages of labour, so it raises the profits of stock, and consequently the interest of money. By the wages of labour being lowered, the owners of what stock remains in the society can bring their goods at less expense to market than before; and less stock being employed in supplying the market than before, they can sell them dearer. Their goods cost them less, and they get more for them. Their profits, therefore, being augmented at both ends, can well afford a large interest. The great fortunes so suddenly and so easily acquired in Bengal and the other British settlements in the East Indies, may satisfy us, that as the wages of labour are very low, so the profits of stock are very high in those ruined countries. The interest of money is proportionably so. In Bengal, money is frequently lent to the farmers at forty, fifty, and sixty per cent. and the succeeding crop is mortgaged for the payment. As the profits which can afford such an interest must eat up almost the whole rent of the landlord, so such enormous usury must in its turn eat up the greater part of those profits. Before the fall of the Roman republic, a usury of the same kind seems to have been common in the provinces, under the ruinous administration of their proconsuls. The virtuous Brutus lent money in Cyprus at eight-and-forty per cent. as we learn from the letters of Cicero.
p11.zh: 然而,社会资本或用于维持工业的资金减少,因为这样会降低劳动工资,从而增加股票的利润,从而增加金钱的利息。 通过降低劳动力工资,社会上所存股票的拥有者能够以比以前更少的成本将商品带入市场;在供应市场时所占用的股票也比以前少,他们可以卖得更珍贵。 他们的商品花得更少,他们得到的更多。 因此,它们的利润在两个方面都得到了增加,这完全可以承受很大的利益。孟加拉和其他东印度群岛的英国定居点如此突然和容易地获得的巨额财富,可能令我们感到满意,因为劳动力工资非常低,所以在这些被破坏的国家,股票利润非常高。钱的利息是成比例的。 在孟加拉,经常向农民贷款40%、50%和60%,而随后的作物则按贷款抵押付款。 由于能够支付这种利息的利润必须几乎耗尽房东的全部租金,因此如此巨大的利息反过来必须耗尽这些利润的很大一部分。罗马共和国倒台之前,一种同类的高利贷似乎在各省很常见,在他们的代宗的废墟管理下.德高望重的布鲁图斯在塞浦路斯以8-40%的利率借钱,我们从西塞罗的信件中了解到这一点。

p12.original: In a country which had acquired that full complement of riches which the nature of its soil and climate, and its situation with respect to other countries, allowed it to acquire, which could, therefore, advance no further, and which was not going backwards, both the wages of labour and the profits of stock would probably be very low. In a country fully peopled in proportion to what either its territory could maintain, or its stock employ, the competition for employment would necessarily be so great as to reduce the wages of labour to what was barely sufficient to keep up the number of labourers, and the country being already fully peopled, that number could never be augmented. In a country fully stocked in proportion to all the business it had to transact, as great a quantity of stock would be employed in every particular branch as the nature and extent of the trade would admit. The competition, therefore, would everywhere be as great, and, consequently, the ordinary profit as low as possible.
p12.zh: 在一个已经获得其土壤和气候性质以及与其他国家相比的财富的国家中,它能够获得这些财富,因此,这些财富不会进一步前进,也不会倒退,因此,劳动工资和股票利润可能都很低。在一个完全与其领土所能维持或所雇用的种群相称的国家,就业竞争必然会非常激烈,以致将劳动工资减少到足以维持劳工人数的水平,而这个国家已经完全人口齐全,因此,这一数目永远不可能增加。在一个完全按照它必须进行交易的所有业务成比例储存的国家中,正如贸易的性质和范围所承认,每个特定分支都将使用大量库存。 因此,竞争将随处可见,因此,普通利润将尽可能低。

p13.original: But, perhaps, no country has ever yet arrived at this degree of opulence. China seems to have been long stationary, and had, probably, long ago acquired that full complement of riches which is consistent with the nature of its laws and institutions. But this complement may be much inferior to what, with other laws and institutions, the nature of its soil, climate, and situation, might admit of. A country which neglects or despises foreign commerce, and which admits the vessel of foreign nations into one or two of its ports only, cannot transact the same quantity of business which it might do with different laws and institutions. In a country, too, where, though the rich, or the owners of large capitals, enjoy a good deal of security, the poor, or the owners of small capitals, enjoy scarce any, but are liable, under the pretence of justice, to be pillaged and plundered at any time by the inferior mandarins, the quantity of stock employed in all the different branches of business transacted within it, can never be equal to what the nature and extent of that business might admit. In every different branch, the oppression of the poor must establish the monopoly of the rich, who, by engrossing the whole trade to themselves, will be able to make very large profits. Twelve per cent. accordingly, is said to be the common interest of money in China, and the ordinary profits of stock must be sufficient to afford this large interest.
p13.zh: 但是,也许还没有一个国家达到这种程度的富足程度。 中国似乎长期处于静止状态,很可能是很久以前就已经获得了与其法律和机构性质相符的财富。 但是,这种补充可能远远低于与其他法律和机构相比,其土壤、气候和情况的性质可能承认的程度。一国忽视或轻视外国商业,只允许外国船只进入其一两个港口,但不能进行与不同法律和机构可能涉及的同等数量的业务。 在一个国家中,虽然富人或大首都的拥有者享有大量安全,但穷人或小首都的拥有者却享有很少的安全,但在正义的幌子下,他们要随时被低级的普通话人掠夺和掠夺,在它内部交易的所有不同商业分支中所使用的库存数量永远不能等同于该商业可能承认的性质和程度。 在每一个不同的分支中,对穷人的压迫必须建立富人的垄断,富人的垄断通过将整个贸易集中到自己身上,就能获得非常巨大的利润. 因此,据说,12%是钱在中国的共同利益,股票的普通利润必须足以支付这笔巨额利息。

p14.original: A defect in the law may sometimes raise the rate of interest considerably above what the condition of the country, as to wealth or poverty, would require. When the law does not enforce the performance of contracts, it puts all borrowers nearly upon the same footing with bankrupts, or people of doubtful credit, in better regulated countries. The uncertainty of recovering his money makes the lender exact the same usurious interest which is usually required from bankrupts. Among the barbarous nations who overran the western provinces of the Roman empire, the performance of contracts was left for many ages to the faith of the contracting parties. The courts of justice of their kings seldom intermeddled in it. The high rate of interest which took place in those ancient times, may, perhaps, be partly accounted for from this cause.
p14.zh: 法律上的缺陷有时可能使利率大大高于国家条件(财富或贫困)要求的利率。 当法律不强制履行合同时,它将所有借款人与受更好监管国家的破产者或信用可疑者置于几乎相同的地位。收回他的钱的不确定性使得贷款人收取的利息与破产者通常必须收取的利息相同。 在横跨罗马帝国西部省份的野蛮国家中,合同的履行被许多年留给了缔约双方的信仰.其国王的法院很少混入其中。 这些古代的高利率也许可以部分归因于这一原因。

p15.original: When the law prohibits interest altogether, it does not prevent it. Many people must borrow, and nobody will lend without such a consideration for the use of their money as is suitable, not only to what can be made by the use of it, but to the difficulty and danger of evading the law. The high rate of interest among all Mahometan nations is accounted for by M. Montesquieu, not from their poverty, but partly from this, and partly from the difficulty of recovering the money.
p15.zh: 当法律完全禁止利息时,它不会阻止利息。许多人必须借钱,没有考虑他们钱的用途,谁也不会放贷,这不但是为了用钱所能做的,而且是为了逃避法律的困难和危险. 马荷梅丹所有民族的高利率由M公司负责。蒙特斯基厄,不是来自他们的贫困,而是部分来自这个,还有一部分来自收回资金的难度.

p16.original: The lowest ordinary rate of profit must always be something more than what is sufficient to compensate the occasional losses to which every employment of stock is exposed. It is this surplus only which is neat or clear profit. What is called gross profit, comprehends frequently not only this surplus, but what is retained for compensating such extraordinary losses. The interest which the borrower can afford to pay is in proportion to the clear profit only. The lowest ordinary rate of interest must, in the same manner, be something more than sufficient to compensate the occasional losses to which lending, even with tolerable prudence, is exposed. Were it not, mere charity or friendship could be the only motives for lending.
p16.zh: 最低的普通利润率必须永远超过足以补偿每一次股票交易所蒙受的偶而损失。 只有这种盈余才有整洁或明显的利润。所谓毛利润不仅经常理解这种盈余,而且理解为补偿这种特别损失而保留的东西。借款人能够支付的利息,只与明显的利润成比例.最低的普通利率必须以同样的方式,足以补偿贷款有时遭受的损失,即使这种损失是可容忍的。 如果不是,仅仅慈善或友谊可能是贷款的唯一动机。

p17.original: In a country which had acquired its full complement of riches, where, in every particular branch of business, there was the greatest quantity of stock that could be employed in it, as the ordinary rate of clear profit would be very small, so the usual market rate of interest which could be afforded out of it would be so low as to render it impossible for any but the very wealthiest people to live upon the interest of their money. All people of small or middling fortunes would be obliged to superintend themselves the employment of their own stocks. It would be necessary that almost every man should be a man of business, or engage in some sort of trade. The province of Holland seems to be approaching near to this state. It is there unfashionable not to be a man of business. Necessity makes it usual for almost every man to be so, and custom everywhere regulates fashion. As it is ridiculous not to dress, so is it, in some measure, not to be employed like other people. As a man of a civil profession seems awkward in a camp or a garrison, and is even in some danger of being despised there, so does an idle man among men of business.
p17.zh: 在一个已经获得其全部财富的国家,在每一个特定的商业分支,可以使用的股票数量最多,因为正常的利润率极低,因此,从中可以提供的通常的市场利率会很低,以致于除了最富有的人之外,任何最富有的人都无法依靠其钱的利益生活。 所有小钱或杂货的人都有义务自行解决自己股票的雇用问题。几乎每一个人都必须是商人,或从事某种贸易。 荷兰省似乎接近这个州. 不做一个生意人是件不时髦的事。必要条件使得几乎每个人都能这样,各地的风俗习惯都规范时尚. 因为不穿衣服是荒谬的,所以,在某种程度上,不象其他人一样被雇用也是荒谬的.身为民间职业的人,在营地或守军中似乎很尴尬,甚至有被轻视的危险,在商人中闲置的人也一样.

p18.original: The highest ordinary rate of profit may be such as, in the price of the greater part of commodities, eats up the whole of what should go to the rent of the land, and leaves only what is sufficient to pay the labour of preparing and bringing them to market, according to the lowest rate at which labour can anywhere be paid, the bare subsistence of the labourer. The workman must always have been fed in some way or other while he was about the work, but the landlord may not always have been paid. The profits of the trade which the servants of the East India Company carry on in Bengal may not, perhaps, be very far from this rate.
p18.zh: 普通利润最高的可能是,在大部分商品的价格上,将全部应该用于土地租借的所得全部吃掉,只留下足以支付准备和将其带入市场的劳力,按照任何地方都能支付劳力的最低比率,工人的赤裸裸的生计.工人在工作期间一定总是以某种方式喂食,但地主可能并不总是领到报酬.东印度公司的佣人在孟加拉进行的贸易利润也许与这一利率相差不大。

p19.original: The proportion which the usual market rate of interest ought to bear to the ordinary rate of clear profit, necessarily varies as profit rises or falls. Double interest is in Great Britain reckoned what the merchants call a good, moderate, reasonable profit; terms which, I apprehend, mean no more than a common and usual profit. In a country where the ordinary rate of clear profit is eight or ten per cent. it may be reasonable that one half of it should go to interest, wherever business is carried on with borrowed money. The stock is at the risk of the borrower, who, as it were, insures it to the lender; and four or five per cent. may, in the greater part of trades, be both a sufficient profit upon the risk of this insurance, and a sufficient recompence for the trouble of employing the stock. But the proportion between interest and clear profit might not be the same in countries where the ordinary rate of profit was either a good deal lower, or a good deal higher. If it were a good deal lower, one half of it, perhaps, could not be afforded for interest; and more might be afforded if it were a good deal higher.
p19.zh: 通常的市场利率与正常的利润率的比例必然随着利润的上升或下降而变化。双重利益在大不列颠是被商人们称为良好、温和、合理的利润所估测的;我所理解的条件是,其意义只是普通和通常的利润。 在正常的利润率为8%或10%的国家,无论以借钱进行业务,其中一半归息也许是合理的。股票的风险在于借款人,借款人按原样向贷款人投保;而4%或5%的股份,在大部分交易中,既可因这种保险的风险而获得足够的利润,也可因使用股票而获得足够的补偿。 但是,在通常利润率低得多或高得多的国家,利息与明显利润的比例可能不同。 如果价格低一些,那么其中一半也许不能用于利息;如果价格高一些,则可能获得更多的利息。

p20.original: In countries which are fast advancing to riches, the low rate of profit may, in the price of many commodities, compensate the high wages of labour, and enable those countries to sell as cheap as their less thriving neighbours, among whom the wages of labour may be lower.
p20.zh: 在迅速走向财富的国家,许多商品价格的低利润率可能补偿高额的劳动工资,使这些国家能够像较不繁荣的邻国一样廉价出售,其中的劳动工资可能较低。

p21.original: In reality, high profits tend much more to raise the price of work than high wages. If, in the linen manufacture, for example, the wages of the different working people, the flax-dressers, the spinners, the weavers, etc. should all of them be advanced twopence a-day, it would be necessary to heighten the price of a piece of linen only by a number of twopences equal to the number of people that had been employed about it, multiplied by the number of days during which they had been so employed. That part of the price of the commodity which resolved itself into the wages, would, through all the different stages of the manufacture, rise only in arithmetical proportion to this rise of wages. But if the profits of all the different employers of those working people should be raised five per cent. that part of the price of the commodity which resolved itself into profit would, through all the different stages of the manufacture, rise in geometrical proportion to this rise of profit. The employer of the flax dressers would, in selling his flax, require an additional five per cent. upon the whole value of the materials and wages which he advanced to his workmen. The employer of the spinners would require an additional five per cent. both upon the advanced price of the flax, and upon the wages of the spinners. And the employer of the weavers would require alike five per cent. both upon the advanced price of the linen-yarn, and upon the wages of the weavers. In raising the price of commodities, the rise of wages operates in the same manner as simple interest does in the accumulation of debt. The rise of profit operates like compound interest. Our merchants and master manufacturers complain much of the bad effects of high wages in raising the price, and thereby lessening the sale of their goods, both at home and abroad. They say nothing concerning the bad effects of high profits; they are silent with regard to the pernicious effects of their own gains; they complain only of those of other people.
p21.zh: 实际上,高利润往往比高工资更能提高工作价格。 例如,在亚麻制造中,如果每日所有工人们,麻衣工,纺纱工,织布工等的工资都提高两便士,那么只须提高一麻皮片的价格,增加的二便士数等于曾受雇于该麻皮片的人数,乘以曾受雇于该麻皮片的天数.初级商品价格中自成一体的部分,在生产的所有不同阶段,只按工资增长的计算比例上涨。 但是,如果这些工人的所有不同雇主的利润应提高5%。 将自己确定为利润的商品的价格部分,在制造的所有不同阶段,与利润的增加成几何比例上升。制麻厂的雇主在出售其制麻厂时,需要按他向工人提炼的材料和工资的全部价值再加5%。轮机的雇主需要增加5%,无论是在弹性鞋的高级价格上,还是在轮机的薪水上。 而织工的雇主则需要同样5%,既要购买亚伦的高级价格,也要购买织工的工资。 在提高商品价格方面,工资的上涨与单纯利息在债务积累方面的运作方式相同。利润的上升象复合利息一样。 我们的商人和主制造商抱怨高工资对提高价格的有害影响,从而减少国内外商品的销售。 他们不谈高利润的有害影响;他们对自身收益的有害影响保持沉默;他们只抱怨其他人的恶果。
